name: The Star Entertainment Group Limited
summary: The Star Entertainment Group Limited manages entertainment and leisure destinations with gaming, entertainment, and hospitality services in Australia. It operates through three segments: The Star Sydney; The Star Gold Coast; and Treasury Brisbane and The Star Brisbane. The company owns and operates The Star Sydney and The Star Gold Coast, which include hotels, restaurants, bars, theatres, and other entertainment facilities. It also manages Star Brisbane, including casino operations, hotels, restaurants, bars, and other entertainment facilities.
